E0963

A fixed-size list length must be known at compile time, must be an integer, and must fit the target's array-size representation.

What

A fixed-size list length must be known at compile time, must be an integer, and must fit the target's array-size representation.

Why

use a literal, a same-file `@` binding, or another comptime expression that produces an in-range integer; a destructuring pattern must then name exactly that many elements.

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0963

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0963: tests/ui/computed_fixed_list_noninteger.stderr.

Error [E0963]: a fixed-size list length must be an integer, got Float (an approximate binary number)
  --> tests/ui/computed_fixed_list_noninteger.jet:2:18
    |
  2 |     values: [Int#1.5]
    |                  ^^^
 Why: a fixed-size list needs one known number of elements
 Fix: use an integer literal or a compile-time expression that produces Int
